'''Buoys''' were a variety of navigational technology used in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] for a variety of purposes. [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Navigation buoys]] were utilized to mark [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> [[Distress buoy]]s emitted distress signals, acting as a form of [[Distress beacon/Legends|emergency beacon]].<ref name="Godking" /> [[Docking buoy]]s guided [[Starship/Legends|starship]]s through docking stations,<ref name="Elusive" /> while [[missile buoy]]s provided targeting assistance when firing [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="IntroGame" /> Some buoys were utilized terrestrially or within starships themselves, such as [[emergency light buoy]]s, which provided light inside of [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s in cases of low power.<ref name="Courtship" /> [[Hyperspace navigation buoy]]s were not physical buoys, but [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projections that aided in navigation through hyperspace.<ref name="XWingAlliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
